title: Classroom scene with seated masked participants and a handheld audio pack
objects_and_counts: At least six people are visible and individually distinguishable: one male in the foreground (wearing glasses and a blue surgical mask) and at least five others seated behind him (three women clearly visible and two partially visible people at the far left and right edges).

One person in the foreground is holding a small black electronic unit with a short coiled cable and a clip; the device is held in his right hand at chest height and a small lapel microphone or cable is visible running toward his collar.
Two long light-coloured wooden tables are visible: one in the foreground (occupied by the foreground speaker) and one behind it (where several seated people rest their hands).
At least three chairs are visible (one behind each seated person in the mid/background and one for the foreground person); some chair backs are partially obscured.
One flat-panel computer monitor is visible on the rear table roughly centered behind the foreground subject; the monitor is grey/black and is seen facing away from the camera.
One smartphone or small rectangular device is visible lying on the rear table near the hands of the woman in dark clothing (center-left of the image).
Multiple face masks are present: every clearly visible person is wearing a mask (counts match the visible people described).
